newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN TOSS AND ELECT TO FIELD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN TOSS AND ELECT TO FIELD.

text.p: Zimbabwe won the toss and chose to field in the one-day cricket international against England on Sunday.
Zimbabwe: Alistair Campbell (captain), Grant Flower, Andy Waller, Dave Houghton, Andy Flower, Guy Whittall, Craig Evans, Heath Streak, Paul Strang, Eddo Brandes, John Rennie.
England: Mike Atherton (captain), Nick Knight, Alec Stewart, Nasser Hussain, Graham Thorpe, John Crawley, Ronnie Irani, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Chris Silverwood, Allan Mullally.
